title: Clean
description: Removes the outputs the named targets of the project declare, keeping any the workspace tracks as source, and runs the tool's own clean commands when given

targets.description: Targets of the project, each declared output of every configuration is removed

commands.description: The tool's own clean commands, each an argument list

previews.description: The tool's own dry-run forms, run in place of commands under a dry run

cwd.description: Folder the commands run in, relative to the workspace root

dryRun.description: Prints each path and command and removes nothing, as NX_DRY_RUN=true does
